message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of some popular online bookstores where you’ll find **“To Kill a Mockingbird”** (by Harper Lee):

| Online Store | Typical Availability | Notes |
|--------------|----------------------|-------|
| **Amazon.com** | New hardcover, paperback, Kindle e‑book, audiobook | Often has multiple editions and bulk discounts. |
| **Barnes & Noble (bn.com)** | Hardcover, paperbacks, Nook e‑books | Offers “Noble Rewards” points on purchases. |
| **Book Depository** | Free worldwide shipping on all formats | Great option if you’re outside North America/Europe. |
| **Books-A-Million (bam.ca / bam.us)** | Hardcovers, paperbacks, audiobooks | Canadian site offers free delivery within Canada. |
| **IndieBound** | Local independent booksellers’ inventory | Search your ZIP code to see nearby stores carrying it. |
| **Kobo Books** | Kobo e‑readers compatible e‑books | Good choice if you use a Kobo device. |

If you have a specific region or format preference (e.g., only hardback, or looking for discounted used copies), let me know! I can help narrow down the best place to buy from.
